cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: Sphere and tube area lights in Unreal Engine 4/5, Unity HDRP, Frostbite, and custom WebGL2/WebGPU PBR engines
Scaling down representative-point GGX peaks by N_Karis = (alpha / alpha')^2 where alpha' = saturate(alpha + r_s/(2*d))
Locking total integrated specular flux at 1.0000x across all bulb radii instead of blowing out to 4.00x-9.00x
Replacing 64-ray spherical-cap area-light integration with 3 scalar ALU instructions per pixel
not_for: Textured polygonal portals or arbitrary mesh emitters requiring Linearly Transformed Cosines (use Heitz LTC Round 48)
Infinitesimal directional sunlight with zero angular radius
Purely diffuse matte surfaces with zero specular reflectance
